newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary hails China's new criminal law adding provisions on financial crimes including manipulating prices on the finacial markets.

- Management problems of securities houses have become more acute with Beijing ordering banks to withdraw from the securities industry and their securities subsidiaries to be taken over by brokerages.
- A total of 10 percent of 123 billion yuan new batch of state debt has been sold in just 10 days after the issue started on March 1. The issue is scheduled to last until October 20.

- BUSINESS NEWS - China's five special economic development zones including Shenzhen posted an increase of 14.3 percent in Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 1996, 4.6 percentage higher than the nation's average.

- Shanghai-based Pingan Insurance Co reported a premium income of 1.18 billion yuan in 1996, an increase of 186 percent than 1995. Turnover hit 10.5 billion yuan, making it the second largest insurance company in China.
